dataFormatNotes: Moving from the stock Motorola firmware to an AOSP-derived custom ROM for the first time requires wiping /data (different filesystem encryption/format expectations). This is standard custom-ROM guidance, not cancunf-specific, and must still be reconfirmed on the official instructions page for the exact build used.
kernelSuNotes: KernelSU officially supports GKI 2.0 kernels (5.10+) with a matching KMI; a non-GKI or older kernel needs a manually built KernelSU kernel, which this app will not attempt to source or flash blindly. Whether the Infinity-X cancunf build ships a KernelSU-enabled kernel out of the box has not been confirmed -- VERIFY_KERNELSU_COMPATIBILITY must check the installed kernel's 'uname -r' string and the boot image itself (see KernelSuCompatibilityChecker) rather than assuming compatibility from the ROM's name or Android version.
